abstract: Many years ago, I was watching the Winter Olympics on a CRT-based High-Definition TV in a development lab at work. ATSC was just becoming a standard, and I was astonished by the quality of the specular reflections in the ice during speed skating. I could not imagine what a 4K image would look like, let alone see it on a ${\$}$ 500 display. Nor could I imagine a day when millions of dollars' worth of live production gear would give way to some big, nebulous thing that everyone would call “the cloud.” Yet, here we are.
